content_reference.example: Ví dụ 05 — Hoàn tất bài toán chiếc hộp

concept: Cùng tấm bìa vuông 30 cm: hộp cao hơn có đáy nhỏ hơn; chọn x=5 cm cho thể tích lớn nhất.
style_reference: ZO red/yellow/charcoal palette and restrained geometric line illustration, adapted to open boxes
alt: Ba hộp không nắp từ cùng tấm bìa: cao 2, 5 và 10 cm; hộp 5 cm được nhấn đỏ vàng vì có thể tích lớn nhất.

1x1.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: supplied transparent illustration of three open square-base boxes. Recompose into square canvas. Arrange 2 cm box upper left, 10 cm box upper right, larger highlighted 5 cm box centered below. Maintain exact visual language of reference: precise isometric straight edges, restrained uniform rounded linework, charcoal #3E3A35 for boxes 2 cm and 10 cm, red #EF5350 edges and yellow #FFCA28 interior floor for box 5 cm. Preserve the THREE distinct shapes: very wide shallow open box height2 base26; medium wide open box height5 base20; narrow tall open box height10 base10. Same scale across boxes. No lids. Exactly one label immediately below each respective box, verbatim '2 cm', '5 cm', '10 cm' in matching charcoal sans serif. Exactly three boxes, no additional objects, axes, equations, captions, arrows, scenery or decorations. Transparent background, no cast shadow. Generous safe margins, fill the specified aspect ratio thoughtfully by relocating objects, never squash them.
